caption_L1: This is a bar diagram titled Neonatal mortality rate worldwide from 1990 to 2018 , by region (per 1,000 live births). The y-axis measures geographic region while the x-axis shows 2015.
caption_L2L3: South Asia has the highest neonatal mortality rate worldwide between 1990 and 2018, with 27.5 deaths per 1000 live births. Oceania w/ Australia and New Zealand has the second highest, with 21. Northern Africa has the third highest rate, with 17, and South-East Asia is the fourth highest, with 13. Central Asia is a close fifth, with 12.5. Australia and New Zealand, East Asia, Europe, and North America all have mortality rates less than 5 per 1000 births.
